children: Interparfums extended its exclusive worldwide Roberto Cavalli and Just Cavalli fragrance license for 20 years through Dec. 31, 2046.
Agreement extends Interparfums’ exclusive global license for Roberto Cavalli and Just Cavalli fragrances through 2046.
Interparfums Italia Srl will continue to operate the Cavalli fragrance licenses from Florence with seat of management in Paris.
Company cites Cavalli as one of its fastest-growing brands with new product extensions and successful 2025 launch Serpentine.
Marquee Brands emphasizes long-term role of fragrance in Roberto Cavalli’s global growth strategy.
